notes.title: Launch Day
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First I want to thank everyone who is playing and enjoying Run N’ Gun. I am the producer/gameplay designer of RNG and this is a huge day for me and the people who developed RNG. This is our first major game published on steam as we all pursue a career in the video game industry.

Digital Delights was a team comprised of game design students at DePaul University for our capstone class. RNG is a game made over 6 months and is our accumulative knowledge of our 4 years at DePaul.

If you want to know more about the development of the game here are some links Below,

Have a good launch.
